patches.reason: entity_look: vanilla 26.3 ClientboundMoveEntityPacket.Rot writes onGround before the two rotation bytes; the description has the older order (net/minecraft/network/protocol/game/ClientboundMoveEntityPacket.java)

move_minecart: vanilla 26.3 NewMinecartBehavior.MinecartStep writes position and movement as Vec3 (three doubles each) and both rotations as ROTATION_BYTE; the description has floats (net/minecraft/world/entity/vehicle/minecart/NewMinecartBehavior.java)

update_sign: vanilla 26.3 ServerboundSignUpdatePacket writes the position, the four lines, then the SignTextSlot id (a VarInt), not a leading isFrontText flag (net/minecraft/network/protocol/game/ServerboundSignUpdatePacket.java)
explosion: vanilla 26.3 ClientboundExplodePacket ends with a playSound boolean the description lacks (net/minecraft/network/protocol/game/ClientboundExplodePacket.java)

custom_click_action: vanilla 26.3 ServerboundCustomClickActionPacket sends the id and then the payload length-prefixed (a VarInt byte count, then an optional tag whose absent form is a lone TAG_End), not a presence boolean (net/minecraft/network/protocol/common/ServerboundCustomClickActionPacket.java)

declare_commands: vanilla 26.3 ArgumentTypeInfos registers 62 command argument types (ids 0-61) including context_float_provider (55), context_int_provider (56), slot_source (57), feature (59) and swing_animation (60), all SingletonArgumentInfo with zero wire bytes; the description stops at 56 with dialog misnumbered as 55 (vanilla 58) and uuid as 56 (vanilla 61), and its properties switch lacks void arms for the singleton parsers (net/minecraft/commands/synchronization/ArgumentTypeInfos.java, net/minecraft/commands/synchronization/SingletonArgumentInfo.java)

initialize_world_border: vanilla 26.3 ClientboundInitializeBorderPacket reads/writes lerpTime with readVarLong/writeVarLong (long lerpTime), not VarInt; the description labels speed varint (net/minecraft/network/protocol/game/ClientboundInitializeBorderPacket.java)

open_sign_entity: vanilla 26.3 ClientboundOpenSignEditorPacket writes the position then the SignTextSlot id (a VarInt, BACK 0 / FRONT 1), not an isFrontText flag (net/minecraft/network/protocol/game/ClientboundOpenSignEditorPacket.java)

player_chat: vanilla 26.3 FilterMask PARTIALLY_FILTERED payload is a BIT_SET (a varint byte count followed by raw bytes, BitSet.valueOf(readByteArray)), not an element-counted array of big-endian i64 (net/minecraft/network/chat/FilterMask.java, net/minecraft/network/codec/ByteBufCodecs.java)

player_chat chat decoration parameters: vanilla 26.3 ChatTypeDecoration.Parameter ids are SENDER 0, TARGET 1, CONTENT 2; the description rotates them to content 0, sender 1, target 2 (net/minecraft/network/chat/ChatTypeDecoration.java)

player_info: vanilla 26.3 ClientboundPlayerInfoUpdatePacket Action ids are UPDATE_LIST_ORDER 6 and UPDATE_HAT 7, and UPDATE_LISTED carries a boolean; the description swaps the top two flag bits and types listed as varint (net/minecraft/network/protocol/game/ClientboundPlayerInfoUpdatePacket.java)

multi_block_change: vanilla 26.3 ClientboundSectionBlocksUpdatePacket reads/writes each packed block-change entry with readVarLong/writeVarLong (block-state id << 12 | 12-bit section-relative pos), not VarInt; the description labels the records array varint (net/minecraft/network/protocol/game/ClientboundSectionBlocksUpdatePacket.java)

world_border_lerp_size: vanilla 26.3 ClientboundSetBorderLerpSizePacket reads/writes the lerp time with readVarLong/writeVarLong (long lerpTime), not VarInt; the description labels speed varint (net/minecraft/network/protocol/game/ClientboundSetBorderLerpSizePacket.java)

teams: vanilla 26.3 ClientboundSetPlayerTeamPacket Parameters writes displayName, prefix, suffix, visibility, collisionRule, optional color (presence boolean plus VarInt id), then the options byte; the description regressed to the old order with the flags byte second, an unguarded color varint and prefix/suffix last (net/minecraft/network/protocol/game/ClientboundSetPlayerTeamPacket.java)

update_structure_block: vanilla 26.3 ServerboundSetStructureBlockPacket carries seed as a VarLong (readVarLong/writeVarLong, long seed) and flags as a raw bitmask byte (1 ignore_entities, 2 show_air, 4 show_bounding_box, 8 strict); the description has seed varint and a u8 enum mapper that misdecodes combined masks (net/minecraft/network/protocol/game/ServerboundSetStructureBlockPacket.java)

play toServer routes: vanilla 26.3 registers SERVERBOUND_SPECTATOR_ACTION at 0x3f (the swing packet is deleted in 26.3); the description maps 0x3f to arm_animation and leaves the spectator_action type unmapped (net/minecraft/network/protocol/game/GameProtocols.java)

spectator_action: vanilla 26.3 ServerboundSpectatorActionPacket carries a single OPTIONAL_VAR_INT (one varint, 0 absent else id plus 1), not a presence boolean plus varint (net/minecraft/network/protocol/game/ServerboundSpectatorActionPacket.java, net/minecraft/network/codec/ByteBufCodecs.java)

login/respawn SpawnInfo: vanilla 26.3 CommonPlayerSpawnInfo carries gameType as a VarInt idMapper and previousGameType as a single OPTIONAL_VAR_INT (one varint, 0 absent else id plus 1); the description has an i8 mapper and a u8 (net/minecraft/network/protocol/game/CommonPlayerSpawnInfo.java, net/minecraft/world/level/GameType.java)

SlotComponent: vanilla 26.3 SignText carries filteredMessages as an optional 4-message list, and DataComponents registers block_transformer (43, holder), compostable (84, resolvable int), cooking_fuel (85, resolvable int plus float), brewing_fuel (86, resolvable int plus float) and provides_pottery_pattern (117, holder); the description has mandatory filteredMessages and no arms for the five (either-forms are a presence boolean plus const int/float or registry-key string) (net/minecraft/world/level/block/entity/SignText.java, net/minecraft/core/component/DataComponents.java, net/minecraft/world/level/storage/loot/providers/number/ints/ResolvableInt.java)

Particle geyser_plume: vanilla 26.3 GeyserParticleOptions carries a single waterBlocks int while geyser_base/geyser_poof use GeyserBaseParticleOptions (int plus float); the description gives geyser_plume the base shape (net/minecraft/core/particles/ParticleTypes.java, net/minecraft/core/particles/GeyserParticleOptions.java)

entity_update_attributes: vanilla 26.3 registers 40 attributes with air_drag_modifier at 0 shifting every later id (numeric registry ids via holderRegistry); the description has a stale 31-entry table with 26.1 ids (e.g. wire id 1 is armor, the description says armor_toughness) and is missing mining_efficiency, movement_efficiency, oxygen_bonus and sneaking_speed (net/minecraft/world/entity/ai/attributes/Attributes.java, net/minecraft/world/entity/ai/attributes/Attribute.java)
